complicacoes.texto: The Creeper and Jack Ryder are two minds sharing the same body, but are often at odds with one another: the Creeper complains that Ryder holds him back, while Ryder is concerned that the Creeper might be driving him insane.

To distract those coming Corpo a Corpo to discovering the connection between Jack Ryder and the Creeper, Jack Ryder announced on his television show not only that he disapproved of vigilantes, but also offered a million dollar reward to whoever brings the Creeper to justice.
